lines.zh: : 你把我们的衣服藏哪儿了，你这个迷奸犯混蛋？！

lines.en: : I told you, I have no idea how this happened. I don’t even know where {i}my{/i} clothes are.
lines.zh: : 我说了，我也不知道这是怎么发生的。我连{i}自己{/i}的衣服在哪儿都不知道。

lines.en: : LIKE I’M GOING TO BELIEVE THAT!
lines.zh: : 我信你才怪！

lines.en: The truth is that I did have an idea.
lines.zh: 事实是，我确实有点头绪。

lines.en: I remember everything from the moment I woke up here the first time to the moment I woke up the second.
lines.zh: 从我第一次在这里醒来，到第二次醒来，中间的一切我都记得。

lines.en: It’s what comes {i}before{/i} it that I can’t remember.
lines.zh: 我记不起来的是那{i}之前{/i}的事。
不过……

lines.en: That’s a trade I’m willing to make.
lines.zh: 这是一笔我愿意做的交易。

lines.en: Because I’m sure whatever that was wasn’t significant at all.
lines.zh: 因为我确信那不管是什么，都一点也不重要。

lines.en: And I’m sure it’s a memory I’m okay with parting with.
lines.zh: 而且我确信，那是一段我愿意放手的记忆。

lines.en: {i}Futaba and Makoto send Sensei back to the beach first so they can clean themselves off and repair their broken bathing suits.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 和 Makoto 先让 Sensei 回海滩去，好让她们把自己弄干净，再把破掉的泳衣修补一下。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He swears to himself along the way to never tell a soul about this.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他在回程的路上对自己发誓，绝不向任何人透露这件事。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And prays to a god he does not believe in that the two of them never remember the details.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}还向一个他并不信仰的神祈祷，希望她们两个永远想不起那些细节。{/i}
